title: Star Wars: A New Hope
synopsis: Tatooine. Two suns. Aunt Beru's blue milk. A droid you bought yesterday is, apparently, carrying the plans to a planet-killing weapon. Buckle up.

nodes.text: You stand watching them set. You want to be anywhere else.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Family.
“Plan to leave” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Hope.

nodes.text: R2 has a message for an Obi-Wan Kenobi. Uncle Owen says forget it.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Stormtroopers killed the Jawas. The droids, you realize, are wanted.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Run home” back. Family shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Strategic—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: They are dead, the homestead burning. You stand in the smoke.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Vow.” The story records the instinct as “Anger” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Mourn.” The story records the instinct as “Grief” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Obi-Wan tells you the truth about your father. He hands you a lightsaber.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Take it” back. Path shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.

nodes.text: Mos Eisley. Aliens. A pilot with a Wookiee.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Speed.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Cautious.

nodes.text: Hyperspace. The galaxy stretches. You realize the universe is huge.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Discipline—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wonder—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Captured by the Death Star. You hide in smuggling holds.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Disguise as stormtroopers.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Wait it out.” The story records the instinct as “Cautious” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Leia is in a cell. You rescue her in a trash compactor.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Save her quickly” back. Hero shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Plan.

nodes.text: Eyes in the water. Walls closing in. The droids save you.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Friend—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Push the walls.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You watch Ben let Vader strike him down. You feel him afterward, in your head.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.
You commit to “Look away.” The story records the instinct as “Anger” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The Rebel base. Briefing. The Death Star approaches.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Volunteer for X-wing.” The story records the instinct as “Hero” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Cautious.

nodes.text: You climb in. Biggs nods. R2 chirps.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Friend—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Trust your training.” The story records the instinct as “Solo” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Lasers. Towers. Wedge falls back. Biggs goes down.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Stay on target” back. Discipline shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Veer to avoid” back. Survival shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Vader is on your tail. Han, you'd swear, is not coming.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Faith.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Reason.

nodes.text: The Falcon comes screaming in. Vader spins off.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Take the shot” back. Now shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Patient.

nodes.text: Two-meter exhaust port. You feel Ben's voice. You let go.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Hope.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.

nodes.text: The whole moon-sized weapon comes apart. You fly out of the cloud.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Joy.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Pilot.

nodes.text: Leia gives you and Han medals. Chewie is, briefly, snubbed.

choices.consequence: “Notice the Chewie thing publicly” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Style—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The Rebellion has many fights ahead. The galaxy is still mostly the Empire.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Path.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You hold it in your hand. The weight is real. The path, you realize, is yours.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Train.” The story records the instinct as “Jedi” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Train slowly.” The story records the instinct as “Patient” and carries it forward.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You find Yoda. You train. You meet your father. You become, in time, the Jedi the galaxy needed. The Force, you decide, is family.
You stay with Rogue Squadron. You fly forever. Han calls you kid for the rest of your life. You never quite mind it.
Years later you start a new Jedi Order. The first new students are not all young. The Force, you teach them, is older than any of them.
